def solve_ramsey(n, k, l):
    # n vertices, no clique of size k, no independent set of size l
    # Variables: x_{i,j} for 0 <= i < j < n, true if edge (i,j) exists
    def get_var(i, j):
        if i > j: i, j = j, i
        return i * n + j - i * (i + 1) // 2 + 1

    solver = Glucose3()

    # No clique of size k
    import itertools
    for clique in itertools.combinations(range(n), k):
        # At least one edge must be missing in any k-subset
        # The edges in the clique are (u, v) for u, v in clique, u < v
        # The clause is: (not x_{u,v} for all u,v in clique)
        clause = [-get_var(u, v) for u, v in itertools.combinations(clique, 2)]
        solver.add_clause(clause)

    # No independent set of size l
    for indset in itertools.combinations(range(n), l):
        # At least one edge must exist in any l-subset
        # The clause is: (x_{u,v} for all u,v in indset)
        clause = [get_var(u, v) for u, v in itertools.combinations(indset, 2)]
        solver.add_clause(clause)

    if solver.solve():
        return solver.get_model()
    else:
        return None
